channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Marc Gasol | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Marc Gasol from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: David Adelman on Marc Gasol, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Adelman on possibly playing more drop w/Jokic:

“He won't be just at the rim like he's Gobert ...I think what we're trying to create with him, he's so high-IQ, is the Marc Gasol model where he's choosing his levels depending on the quality of player or what the player does well.”

David Adelman on Marc Gasol, Nikola Jokic, Oct 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tony Allen on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol
item.description:
Tony Allen:

“Then he looks dead at Z-Bo. He’s like, 'Z-Bo, get a [explicit] rebound that matters! Quit telling Mike to move out to get rebounds!' I’m like, 'Damn!' Then he looks dead at Marc (Gasol). He’s like, 'Marc, who the [explicit] told you you were our Sabonis? Get your ass in the paint and make some points!' I’m sitting there like, 'Damn, coach is on one.'Then he looks at Mike Conley and says, 'Mike Conley, you know what happened?' Man, I swear, coach was just on everybody that day, but I respected it because it was tough love. That’s the type of energy I’ve been looking for, and it made me want to run through a wall for him.”

Tony Allen on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol, Nov 24, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Marc Gasol, who’s jersey will be retired in Memphis tonight:

“He was a huge part of our championship team in Toronto. He’s just such a good player, man. Such a good smart, tough, player, and a great pro. I have nothing but great memories about Marc.”

Nick Nurse on Marc Gasol, Apr 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: David Fizdale on Marc Gasol
item.description:
“I tried to coach Marc Gasol like I coached kids from the ‘hood, but I hadn’t gained enough trust from him,”

David Fizdale on Marc Gasol, Jun 24, 2021. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Andre Drummond on Marc Gasol:

“Marc has probably been the biggest help for me since I got here. ... I admire his game. ... He's been very beneficial for me.”

Andre Drummond on Marc Gasol, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on playing Marc Gasol and Montrezl Harrell at the same time:

“It's tough to play two bigs in the modern NBA. Two centers.”

Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Michael Singer:Nikola Jokic:

“I think we all forget who Marc Gasol is. The guy who won two defensive players of the year.”

Nikola Jokic on Marc Gasol, May 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Chris Boucher on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Boucher on Gasol's situationw/Lakers:

“I don't know what they're doing over there but Marc Gasol's a great player & I don't think he's somebody that you can't play... I don't think that should be the situation..(He's) still got it at his age & can still bring a lot to the team”

Chris Boucher on Marc Gasol, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Siakam on Gasol:

“Marc is a great guy overall, man. He's just one of those people that you love to be around. As a big brother here he kinda took all of us in a little bit and taught us a lot of things... He's just a great vet all around... He's a great person.”

Pascal Siakam on Marc Gasol, Apr 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol
item.description:
After the Lakers defeated the Kings, the topic once again came up during postgame press conference.

“I think people need to understand how good of a player Marc Gasol is and how valuable he is to what we’re doing,”

Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol, Apr 3, 2021. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol’s role:

“He’s out there to defend, rebound and playmake from the top of the key … We’re not asking him to be a scorer in our offense.”

Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol, Feb 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on if the Nuggets are currently at the Lakers' level:

“I think we need to work a little bit more to get to their level. Just because they have more experience than us, the players. Marc Gasol, he's a winner, he won a championship, won a world championship...”

Nikola Jokic on Marc Gasol, Feb 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: LeBron James on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Ryan Ward:LeBron on getting Marc Gasol more involved:

“I just think playing through him a lot more. When we do that, we're very good because of his ability to see the floor, pass the ball. He does some special things out on the floor. ... We're going to get him more involved...”

LeBron James on Marc Gasol, Jan 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Markieff Morris on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Markieff Morris on Marc Gasol & last yr's Lakers bigs:

“Marc is going to be able to space the floor, pass the ball, but we won't see the crazy dunks & the crazy blocks from him...the versatility of the bigs we had last year will be a lot different this year.”

Markieff Morris on Marc Gasol, Dec 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Wesley Matthews, Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
“When you have talented guys like LeBron and AD things on the offensive end are going to work themselves out. “You look at the guys we added: Schroder I think is a pit bull of a defender. Montrezl Harrell is one of the hardest-playing players in the NBA, just the way he brings it every night. I think Marc Gasol, [the 2013] defensive player of the year who is one of the highest-IQ players in today’s game, and then Wesley Matthews, who manages to stand out.”

Rob Pelinka on Wesley Matthews, Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell, Dec 5, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:VanVleet on Gasol:

“I think it was the haircut. He got a little bit more aerodynamic.”

Fred VanVleet on Marc Gasol, Sep 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Bruno Caboclo on Marc Gasol
item.description:
After Memphis signed him away from Rio Grande in January, Caboclo played in 34 games (19 starts) and averaged 8.3 points, 4.5 rebounds and 1.5 assists while shooting 36.9% from three-point range in 23.5 minutes per contest—all career-high marks.

“They welcomed me from the first day. Marc Gasol was there, he treated me very well before he was traded,”

Bruno Caboclo on Marc Gasol, May 24, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Pascal Siakam on Toronto's two-headed monster at C of Ibaka and Gasol:

“Obviously Serge has been playing unbelievable the whole time with all the injuries. He’s been great. Having those two guys coming in and out is a nightmare for the other team,”

Pascal Siakam on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Jan 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Marc Gasol
item.description:
LaVine afterward said he should’ve passed to a wide-open Daniel Gafford, in for the fouled-out Wendell Carter Jr.

“I saw Marc Gasol there. I tried to get him in the air and draw a foul. I’ve looked at now. I just wish I would’ve took an extra dribble to see the double-team on me,”

Zach LaVine on Marc Gasol, Dec 10, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Nick Nurse on when he'll make a call on Ibaka or Gasol as the starting C:

“Soon. I’m looking at it. I will continue to evaluate the units playing together.”

Nick Nurse on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Mar 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:VanVleet on Marc Gasol:

“He's one of the best fives in the league for a long time now, a perennial all-star, defensive player of the year. So just really excited to see how we can acclimate him to what we do and see how much he can give us a boost.”

Fred VanVleet on Marc Gasol, Feb 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Mike Conley on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Mike Conley on Marc Gasol potentially being traded tonight:

“Knowing what's possible after tonight, it's going to be hard for a lot of us,especially myself with all the years we've played together.”

Mike Conley on Marc Gasol, Feb 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Steve Kerr on Mike Conley and Marc Gasol:

“You put a 1 and a 5 together who are All Star-caliber players and are great passers, they're going to build a synergy... They're great players.”

Steve Kerr on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol, Nov 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Robert Pera on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol
item.description:
Pera is optimistic that the franchise can bounce back after having its seven-year playoff run end abruptly.

“Assuming Marc (Gasol) and Mike (Conley) come back healthy, I think we have a couple of surrounding pieces that are younger players that are going to make a positive impact,”

Robert Pera on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol, Jun 12, 2018. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: David Fizdale on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Fizdale on falling out with Gasol:

“I really take ownership on that ... for whatever reason we bumped head on some things.”

David Fizdale on Marc Gasol, May 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @briancmahoney.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Yes, Enes Kanter actually said this today about Willy Hernangomez:

“I think he’s a young version of Marc Gasol. If he works hard enough, he can be as good as Marc Gasol.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on Marc Gasol, Mar 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @meanbarb.

item.title: Chris Wallace on Marc Gasol
item.description:
“Right now, we need Marc Gasol to be what he's capable of, which is one of the elite centers in the league,”

Chris Wallace on Marc Gasol, Dec 1, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Marc Gasol
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Interim coach J.B. Bickerstaff on Marc Gasol:

“Marc is one of the leaders of this team. We need Marc to play his best best basketball... We need Marc Gasol to be Marc Gasol.”

JB Bickerstaff on Marc Gasol, Nov 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: David Fizdale on Marc Gasol
item.description:
“I’m trying to win a game. I’m desperate. I took a risk. Sometimes when you take a risk you may (upset) a player or two. That’s part of this position. I can own the decision and I have my reasons why. Winning is my only priority.”

David Fizdale on Marc Gasol, Nov 27, 2017. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.
